summary: The DOM tests now cover speculation rules more closely, including eager prefetching on hover, activation reaching content, and timing differences between eager and moderate loading. They also expand coverage for XSLT and DOMContentLoaded, JavaScript-module loading and CSP, the Sanitizer API, notification permissions, and WebAssembly behavior when scripting is disabled. Several tests were made less timing-dependent by waiting for layout or reflow instead of using arbitrary delays.
